protein-per-meal.label: Protein per meal to maximise myofibrillar protein synthesis (young adults)
protein-per-meal.value: about 0.3 g·kg⁻¹ of high-quality protein (position stands: 20–40 g), every 3–5 h

protein-daily-athletes.label: Daily protein advised for athletes
protein-daily-athletes.value: 1.2–2.0 g·kg⁻¹·day⁻¹ (ACSM/AND/DC; ISSN 1.4–2.0), about 1.6 a sensible target; RDA for the general population 0.8

cho-recovery-rate.label: Carbohydrate for fast glycogen refilling between sessions
cho-recovery-rate.value: about 1.0–1.2 g·kg⁻¹·h⁻¹ for the first 4 h, starting at once; more adds no glycogen
